text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "pounds", "kind": "mass", "span": "One dwarf can mine 12 pounds of ore per day with his bare hands"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 40, "unit": "dwarves", "kind": "count", "span": "40 dwarves with steel pickaxes"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 30, "unit": "days", "kind": "time", "span": "a month with 30 days"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q1"], "out": "s1", "note": "with an iron pickaxe he mines twice the bare-hands rate"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "q1"], "out": "s2", "note": "a steel pickaxe adds 50% of the iron rate, and half the iron rate is exactly the bare-hands rate"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "q2"], "out": "s3", "note": "daily ore for all 40 dwarves"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q3"], "out": "s4", "note": "ore mined over the 30-day month"}], "target": {"kind": "mass", "scope": "the pounds of ore 40 dwarves with steel pickaxes mine in 30 days"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 1, "reason": "'One dwarf' fixes the per-dwarf basis of the 12 pounds/day rate; it is not an operand"}, {"value": 50, "reason": "the 50% uplift is carried structurally by adding half the iron-pickaxe rate; the bare percentage itself is not an operand"}]}
